device_peq_incompatible_browser_alert: Your browser does not support the necessary APIs to connect to devices. Please use a compatible browser (e.g. Chrome or Edge) and ensure you have the required permissions enabled.
device_peq_transport_hid: USB HID — plug-and-play via WebHID for DAC/amps like FiiO, Moondrop, and KTMicro dongles.
device_peq_transport_serial: USB Serial — for devices exposing a CDC / virtual COM interface (JDS Labs, Nothing, FiiO, and more), including Bluetooth serial ports.
device_peq_transport_ble: Bluetooth — wireless pairing via Web Bluetooth for select FiiO and Airoha-chipset devices.
device_peq_choose_prompt: Several devices match. Pick the profile that fits yours.
device_peq_unsupported: This device isn't in the EQ database.
device_peq_guess_notice: Not in the EQ database: connected with an experimental compatible protocol, so the EQ limits are that protocol's.
device_peq_group_notice: Not in the EQ database: connected with a compatible profile shared by several devices.
device_peq_draft_notice: Not yet checked on a real device.
device_peq_demo_notice: A simulated DAC inside the app, for trying the editor without hardware. It doesn't change what you hear: uniPEQ never processes audio on the phone, only the EQ inside a connected device. Its presets last until the app closes.
device_peq_experimental: This device is connected with an experimental protocol.
device_peq_eq_hint: The EQ preset saved on the device. Changing it applies to the device right away, and Read and Write use the selected preset.
device_peq_eq_switch_hint: Turn the device's built-in EQ on or off. Its EQ settings stay saved in the device.
device_peq_eq_switch_unknown: This device doesn't report whether its EQ is on. Use the switch to set it yourself.
device_peq_preset_hint: Pick the preset to read and write. Picking one here doesn't change the preset the device plays.
device_peq_unreachable: This device can only read and write the preset it's using. Switch the device to the preset you want first.
device_peq_synced: The EQ shown matches the device.
device_peq_unsynced: The EQ has changed since the last read or write.
device_peq_auto_paused: Auto-write paused: some EQ settings don't fit this device.
device_peq_auto_stopped: Auto-write turned off because the last write failed.
device_peq_volume_body: uniPEQ is about to change the EQ on {device}. A write can cause a pop, a dropout or a sudden jump in loudness, so pause playback or turn the volume down while you adjust the EQ.
device_peq_read_title: Replace the band list with the device's EQ
device_peq_write_title: Send the band list to the device
device_peq_write_only: This device can be written to but not read back.
device_peq_read_skipped: {count} band(s) use filter types the equalizer can't show and were left out.
device_peq_status_written_off: Wrote {count} band(s). The device's EQ is off: pick a preset to hear them.
device_peq_status_saved_reconnect: Saved. The device restarts after saving; reconnect to carry on.
device_peq_status_saved_reconnecting: Saved. The device restarts after saving; reconnecting…
device_peq_status_saved_reconnected: Wrote {count} band(s). The device restarted to save and is connected again.
device_peq_status_reconnect_manual: Couldn't find the device again. Plug it in and connect.
device_peq_push_intro: The device can't hold this EQ exactly as shown. This is what it will get:
device_peq_push_dropped: Band {band}: no slot left on the device, not sent
device_peq_push_clip_risk: These bands boost, and this device's level can't be lowered from here. Turn the volume down or reduce the boost to avoid clipping.
device_peq_push_infeasible: Some bands still break one of the device's rules (band order or spacing), so it may reject them.
device_peq_error_timeout: The device didn't answer. Check the cable and try again.
device_peq_error_transport: Lost the connection to the device.
device_peq_error_bad_response: The device answered with something unexpected.
device_peq_error_unrepresentable: A value can't be sent to this device.
device_peq_error_generic: Something went wrong talking to the device.
device_peq_no_device: No supported USB device is attached. Plug one in and try again.
device_control_eq_off: The device doesn't apply its EQ with this {control} setting.
device_control_eq_off_hint: The device doesn't apply its EQ with this setting.
device_control_confirm_body: The device restarts to apply it, and the sound stops for a moment. uniPEQ connects to it again.
device_control_restarted: Changed {control}. The device restarted and is connected again.
device_control_restart_reconnect: Changed {control}. The device restarted; reconnect to carry on.
device_peq_choose_device_prompt: Several devices are attached. Pick one.
bands_empty: No bands yet. Read them from a device or load a preset.
device_peq_connect_demo_title: Connect a simulated DAC to try the editor. It doesn't affect sound
device_peq_builtin: This is one of the device's built-in presets, which this app doesn't overwrite. Pick a user preset to write to.
presets_empty: No saved presets yet. Save the current EQ or import a file.
presets_save_title: Save the current EQ as a preset
presets_import_title: Import a uniPEQ preset (.json) or Equalizer APO / AutoEq text (.txt)
presets_dropped_bands: {count} band(s) used a filter type this app doesn't have and were left out.
presets_skipped_lines: {count} line(s) couldn't be used and were left out.
presets_error_not_a_preset: This file isn't a uniPEQ preset or Equalizer APO / AutoEq text.
presets_error_version: This preset was made by a newer version of uniPEQ.
presets_error_empty: None of the filters in this file can be used.
presets_error_generic: Something went wrong with the preset.
eq_band_misfit: The device won't take this band as it is
eq_band_past_cap: The device has only {max} bands: this one is past them and won't be written.
eq_field_violation: The device won't take this. Allowed: {allowed}
eq_fit_title: Fit the bands to the device's limits
eq_graph_empty: No bands yet. Double-click here, add a band, read a device or load a preset.
eq_graph_help: Drag a band to move it. Arrow keys move the focused band, Page Up and Page Down change its Q, Delete removes it. Pinch or scroll to change the selected band's Q.
eq_misfits: {count} band(s) don't fit {device}. Fit adjusts them to what it takes.
eq_preamp_auto_hint: Follow the bands: cut by the largest boost.
eq_preamp_clips: The bands boost more than this preamp leaves room for, so it may clip. {needed} dB would be enough.
eq_preamp_none_boost: This device has no preamp, and the EQ boosts by up to {boost} dB: turn the volume down or cut instead of boosting to avoid clipping.
eq_preamp_unknown: The device's preamp range isn't known yet, so a write may adjust it.
eq_type_no_gain: This filter type has no gain.
eq_type_violation: The device won't take this filter type here.
settings_auto_delay_hint: How long after the last edit the device is written.
settings_log_export_title: Export the log as a text file
settings_verbose_hint: Also logs the bytes exchanged with the device. Useful for bug reports.
settings_database_never_checked: Never; using the copy built into the app
settings_source_hint: Where device limits and protocols come from
settings_auto_write_hint: Write EQ edits to the device after a short pause.
settings_volume_warning_hint: Before the first write to a device, remind me to lower the volume.
sync_unwritten: Changes not written to the device yet.
sync_unwritten_kept: Earlier changes aren't on the device yet.
sync_not_read: The device's EQ hasn't been read yet.
sync_auto_on: Auto-write is on: your next edit goes to the device.
eq_short: The list has {count} band(s) fewer than {device}. Fit fills them in flat.
eq_empty_fixed: No bands yet. Read them from {device}, or start from {count} flat bands.
eq_empty_body: uniPEQ edits the EQ inside your DAC, amp or headphones. Connect one to start: its bands and limits come with it.
sync_disconnected: {device} is disconnected. Connect it to edit.
presets_apply_needs_device: Connect a device to load a preset
update_ready: A new version of uniPEQ is ready.
link_sheet_text: Enter the code modernGraphTool shows, or paste its link.
link_sheet_invalid: Invalid link code. It should look like ABCD-1234.
link_replace_title: End the link with {current} and link with {host}?
link_approve_text: The site will be able to edit this EQ and write it to your device.
link_go_back: Go back to the browser to finish linking.
link_battery_tip: Android paused uniPEQ while it was linked. Set its battery use to Unrestricted to keep the link running.
link_ended_timeout: The link ended: modernGraphTool stopped answering.
link_ended_update_app: uniPEQ is older than this site's link. Update uniPEQ to link.
link_ended_update_site: This site's modernGraphTool is older than uniPEQ's link. It needs an update.
link_ended_room_full: That link is already in use. Start a new one in modernGraphTool.
env_android_body: Android browsers can't reach USB audio devices. The uniPEQ app can, and it still links with modernGraphTool in your browser.
env_ios_body: iOS gives browsers and apps no access to USB audio devices, so uniPEQ can't reach your device here. Use Chrome or Edge on a computer, or an Android phone.
env_desktop_title: Open uniPEQ in Chrome or Edge
env_desktop_body: This browser can't reach USB devices. Open unipeq.com in a Chromium browser (Chrome, Edge…) on a computer.
env_demo_hint: You can still try the editor with the demo device, though it doesn't affect sound.
intro_welcome_body: uniPEQ lets you edit the parametric EQ stored inside your DAC, amp or headphones.
intro_welcome_hardware: It's a companion app for hardware, so you need a compatible device with a built-in EQ. Without one, the demo device lets you try the editor, but it won't change any sound.
intro_connect_body_native: Plug your device in over USB and uniPEQ connects to it.
intro_connect_body_web: Press Connect and pick your device in the browser's list.
intro_connect_fit: Its own limits shape the editor: how many bands, which filter types, which ranges. If a setting has to change to fit them, uniPEQ asks before writing it to the device.
intro_presets_body: Save presets on this device, or import AutoEq or Equalizer APO files in the Presets tab. Each preset shows whether it can be applied to the connected device.
intro_link_body: In a modernGraphTool-based database, use Hardware EQ → Link with uniPEQ: the EQ you build there against a measurement and a target goes straight to uniPEQ.
intro_link_native: While linked, uniPEQ keeps running in the background, with a notification to unlink.
settings_intro_hint: An introduction to uniPEQ and its features
